[attribute-award-id-type]
=== `@award-id-type` Type of Identifier for an Award

Type of, or name for, an institutional identifier for the <<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>> element, in cases where a type system is being used to identify awards, for example, a DOI.

#### Usage/Remarks
This attribute does not record the type of _award_; it records the type of the _award identifier_ for the element <<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>>. Thus, for example, an <<attribute-award-id-type,`@award-id-type`>> attribute can identify the award ID as a DOI from the Crossref’s DOI-based Grant Identifier system.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Type of or name for an institutional identifier for the <<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>> element, in cases where a type system is being used to identify awards, for example,
                        a DOI.
| Restriction| `@award-id-type` is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
